video_title: Jazz Keeping Walker Kessler?? Ryan Smith Have Playoff Expectations for Utah??

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Smith's approach to the Darren Peterson situation
quotes.excerpt: Is that when you step in and be like, okay, I'm going to go meet this guy?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: When you see this Darren Peterson situation and okay, he's only meeting with Washington, he's not going to meet up, work out with us, is that when you step in and be like, okay, I'm going to go meet this guy? Did you end up meeting with him, right? You guys went to him?

text_blocks.speaker: Ryan Smith
text_blocks.text: Our group went out, but it's something that, I mean, there's reasons why those narratives take off. And the one thing in the NBA is a lot of times, I think we all have to do this, we all have to sit back and be like, okay, that's out there. I've never been in a business where so much is untrue that's out there.

quotes.speaker: Ryan Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Smith on the reality of NBA pre-draft workouts
quotes.excerpt: I don't even call it a workout. I call it dinner.
quotes.quote: We met with Darren at the combine. Darren was awesome in the interview. Darren wanted to go number one, everyone wants to go number one. But by the way, we had three different top guys come in. I don't even call it a workout. I call it dinner. I don't even go. I'm like, okay, I'll go to dinner with you. Because there's no sweat, there's no nothing. They're sitting down with Will watching film. They put on their jersey to check out the size and everything. They take a couple pictures, they call it a workout, but no one's doing the three-minute run to see how fast they can go up and down the court. These aren't workouts at this point.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for the Utah Jazz to be a playoff team
quotes.excerpt: Do you believe the Jazz have a chance of being a playoff team next season?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: When you look at the talent on your roster, do you believe the Jazz have a chance of being a playoff team next season?

text_blocks.speaker: Ryan Smith
text_blocks.text: I don't want to set expectations, but we need to start winning. Right? I think that's where we're at. When we took over, I took over what was the number one team in the regular season. My first day was post-COVID, and I had two weeks to get a deal done with Rudy Gobert and Donovan Mitchell. That team came out, we were number one in the regular season the first year and just got bounced early. And then same thing happened again, the trade, the LA Clippers situation, if you remember that game. That was where we lost our soul a little bit, but that's part of hoops and then we had to start over.

quotes.speaker: Ryan Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Smith on rebuilding the Utah Jazz roster
quotes.excerpt: We're in a pretty good spot. We've got a lot of the good pieces, we got to be patient.
quotes.quote: It's really not the way you want to come in and start your tenure for our ownership group, is like tear it all down. I'm a pretty competitive person, I like to win. Danny is about as competitive as any human on the planet. We're just at this phase where it's like, okay, we want to go, but we want to do it the right way. And so I think we're in a pretty good spot. We've got a lot of the good pieces, we got to be patient. We know who we're competing against, which is pretty clear for the next few years and I think our roster offers a different look, and I think that's a good thing.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler's future with the Utah Jazz
quotes.excerpt: Walker Kessler obviously is a big piece. We expect him to come back.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Walker Kessler obviously is a big piece. We expect him to come back. What's the situation like there?

text_blocks.speaker: Ryan Smith
text_blocks.text: We love Walk. He's a big piece of where we're going.
